structured_output.what_is_happening: SIGNULL is a 3-day-old pump.fun coin that has already migrated to PumpSwap. It references signüll (@signulll), who was ranked #1 on etn.'s "ETN100" list of the most influential tech posters on X, announced around Sept 22, 2026. Creator fees are routed to @signulll through UsePaid. The coin sat dormant for about 3 days, then in the last ~15-30 minutes it rose about 1300% (from ~$4k to ~$60k mcap) on ~$150k volume and ~320 unique buyers. The latest 5 minutes show -30% on GeckoTerminal, a pullback already under way. I could not find what triggered the revival, such as a post by signulll or a fee claim.

narrative.description: A tribute/fee-routing coin for signulll, the tech poster ranked #1 on the ETN100 list. The event is real but narrow: an X influence list announced 3 days ago.
narrative.why_spreading: Unknown. The likely cause is a new signulll tweet, a UsePaid fee payout, or a KOL/call-channel pickup that revived the dormant coin, but I found none of these. A niche tech-Twitter personality has a limited crypto-degen audience.

token_connection.why_this_token: Fees go to @signulll via UsePaid, and the linked website is the actual ETN100 list. The packet shows no same-ticker competitors.

authenticity.evidence: About 320 unique buyers in 30 minutes is real breadth. But GMGN flags 769 bundler wallets, 645 fresh wallets, a bot/degen rate of 0.57 and a top bundler trader share of 20%. The deployer has launched 526 tokens. The project X account has been renamed (belmarmode → esotericpigeon). A community-takeover flag is set. 85 smart and 11 renowned wallets are among the traders.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts, so I don't know whether signulll himself engaged.

structural_risks: Serial deployer (526 tokens) funded from Gate.io

structured_output.thesis: The story is real but niche: signulll ranked #1 on the ETN100, with fees routed to him. It is 3 days stale, and the coin suddenly pumped 13x with no visible trigger, heavy bundler/fresh-wallet flags and a serial deployer. Entry comes after the vertical move with price already fading. The odds of a clean 2x before -50% are about average for this pool.
